lessons.title: Jobs and workplaces
lessons.goal_uz: Kasblarni tushuntirasiz va who / which / where bilan aniqlovchi ergash gap tuzasiz.

words.ex: My colleagues are very helpful.
The salary is good, but the hours are long.
She is responsible for the marketing team.
I deal with customer complaints.
We have a deadline on Friday.
Nurses often work night shifts.
He has a part-time job in a café.
This job needs good communication skills.

steps.title: Three people, three jobs
steps.text: Aziza is a software developer who works for a bank in Tashkent. She is responsible for the bank's mobile app, and she often works with colleagues who live in other countries. Rustam is a chef in a restaurant which is famous for its modern Uzbek food. He works long shifts, but he loves creating new dishes. Kamila works part-time in a hospital where her mother also works. She deals with patients at the reception desk while she studies medicine at university. All three say the same thing: the best job is one which uses your skills and makes you want to learn more.
steps.uz: Aziza — Toshkentdagi bankda ishlaydigan dasturchi. U bankning mobil ilovasi uchun mas'ul va ko'pincha boshqa mamlakatlarda yashaydigan hamkasblari bilan ishlaydi. Rustam zamonaviy o'zbek taomlari bilan mashhur restoranda oshpaz. U uzoq smenalarda ishlaydi, lekin yangi taomlar yaratishni yaxshi ko'radi. Kamila onasi ham ishlaydigan kasalxonada yarim stavkada ishlaydi. U universitetda tibbiyot o'qir ekan, qabulxonada bemorlar bilan ishlaydi. Uchalasi ham bir xil gapni aytadi: eng yaxshi ish — ko'nikmalaringdan foydalanadigan va ko'proq o'rganishga undaydigan ish.

steps.explain_uz: "She is responsible for the bank's mobile app".

options: She works in a restaurant too.

steps.title_uz: Aniqlovchi ergash gap: who / which / that / where
steps.body_uz:
O'zbekchada aniqlovchi otdan **oldin** keladi: "bankda **ishlaydigan** dasturchi". Ingliz tilida esa **otdan keyin**, maxsus so'z bilan:
**who** — odamlar uchun: a developer **who works** for a bank
**which** — narsa/hayvon uchun: a restaurant **which is** famous
**that** — odam va narsa uchun (og'zaki nutqda keng): the job **that** I want
**where** — joy uchun: the hospital **where** her mother works
Diqqat: ikkinchi ega takrorlanmaydi! a man who **he** works here ✘ → a man who works here ✔

examples.en: A pilot is a person who flies planes.
This is the laptop which I bought last week.
examples.uz: Bu men o'tgan hafta sotib olgan noutbuk.

examples.en: That's the office where my father works.
I need a job that pays well.
examples.uz: Menga yaxshi maosh to'laydigan ish kerak.

steps.q: A dentist is a doctor ___ looks after your teeth.
This is the café ___ I work on Saturdays.

options: I have a colleague who she speaks Korean.
I have a colleague who speaks Korean.
I have a colleague which speaks Korean.
steps.explain_uz: who'dan keyin **she** takrorlanmaydi; odam uchun **which** emas.

steps.text: It's a job ___ needs good communication skills.
answer: which
that
steps.uz: Bu yaxshi muloqot ko'nikmalarini talab qiladigan ish.

answer: on

steps.text: She is responsible ___ the whole team.
answer: for

steps.q: What does the speaker dislike about her job?
steps.say: I love my colleagues and the salary is fine, but I hate the night shifts. I never get enough sleep.

answer: I need a job that pays well.
I need a job that pays well
This is the company where I work
This is the company that I work for
This is the company which I work for
This is the company I work for
It's the company where I work

steps.text: I'd like a job which uses my skills and lets me work with people from other countries.

steps.prompt_uz: Oilangizdagi bir kishining yoki orzuingizdagi kasbni tasvirlang (5–6 gap): nima qiladi, nima uchun mas'ul, qanday ko'nikmalar kerak. Kamida 2 ta who / which / where ishlating.
steps.prompt: Describe a job (a family member's or your dream job): duties, responsibilities and skills. Use who, which or where at least twice.
steps.example: My uncle is an engineer who works for a company which builds bridges. He is responsible for checking that every bridge is safe. He often travels to small towns where new roads are being built. His job needs strong maths skills and a lot of patience. I think it's a job that really helps people.

lessons.title: Studying abroad
lessons.goal_uz: Real imkoniyatlar va natijalar haqida First Conditional (If ... , I will ...) bilan gapirasiz.

words.ex: I'm going to apply to three universities.
The main requirement is IELTS 6.5.
Tuition fees in the UK are very high.
The university offers student accommodation.
If they accept me, I'll move to Seoul.
I felt homesick in my first month.
You won't pass unless you practise.
I'll call you as soon as I get the results.

steps.title: Talking to an education consultant
steps.context_uz: Sevara chet elda o'qish bo'yicha maslahatchi bilan gaplashmoqda.

lines.en: I'd like to study business in the UK. What are the main requirements?
lines.uz: Buyuk Britaniyada biznes o'qimoqchiman. Asosiy talablar qanday?

lines.en: Most universities ask for IELTS 6.5. If you get 6.5, you'll have a good choice of programmes.
lines.uz: Ko'p universitetlar IELTS 6.5 so'raydi. Agar 6.5 olsangiz, dasturlardan tanlash imkoniyatingiz katta bo'ladi.

lines.en: And what will happen if I only get 6.0?
Then you'll probably need a pre-sessional English course before you start.
lines.uz: Unda boshlashdan oldin ehtimol tayyorlov ingliz tili kursi kerak bo'ladi.

lines.en: The tuition fees are really high. Are there any scholarships?
lines.uz: O'qish to'lovlari juda yuqori. Grantlar bormi?

lines.en: Yes, but the deadlines are early. You won't get one unless you apply by January.
lines.uz: Ha, lekin muddatlari erta. Yanvargacha topshirmasangiz, ololmaysiz.

lines.en: OK. I'll start my application as soon as I get my IELTS results.
lines.uz: Xo'p. IELTS natijamni olishim bilanoq arizamni boshlayman.

steps.q: What score do most universities ask for?
What will Sevara need if she gets 6.0?
steps.explain_uz: "you'll probably need a pre-sessional English course".

steps.body_uz:
Kelajakda **haqiqatan sodir bo'lishi mumkin** bo'lgan holat va uning natijasi:
**If + Present Simple, will + fe'l**
If I **get** 6.5, I **will apply** to Manchester.
Eng ko'p xato: If I **will get**... ✘ — If qismida **will qo'yilmaydi** (o'zbekchadagi "olsam" kabi).
Qismlar o'rnini almashtirish mumkin: I'll apply to Manchester **if** I get 6.5. (vergulsiz)
**unless** = if ... not: You won't pass **unless** you practise. (= if you don't practise)
Vaqt bog'lovchilari ham shunday: **when / as soon as / before / after** + Present Simple: I'll call you **as soon as** I **arrive**.

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
If they accept me, I'll move to Seoul.
You won't get a visa unless you show your bank statement.
I'll message you when I land.

steps.q: If I ___ a scholarship, I'll study in Germany.
You won't improve ___ you practise every day.
I'll call you as soon as I ___ the results.

steps.text: If you study hard, you ___ pass the exam.
answer: will
'll

steps.text: I'll feel homesick if I ___ (not / call) my family often.
answer: don't call
do not call
steps.uz: Oilamga tez-tez qo'ng'iroq qilmasam, sog'inib qolaman.
Agar meni qabul qilishsa, Seulga ko'chaman.

steps.say: I'm not going to book my flight until I get my visa. If everything goes well, I'll fly in early September.
steps.explain_uz: "not ... until I get my visa" — vizani olgandan keyin.

answer: I'll call you as soon as I get the results.
I'll call you as soon as I get the results

steps.uz: Agar IELTSdan 7 olsam, grantga ariza topshiraman.
answer: If I get 7 in IELTS, I'll apply for a scholarship
If I get a 7 in IELTS, I'll apply for a scholarship
If I get band 7 in IELTS, I will apply for a scholarship
If I get 7 in IELTS, I will apply for a scholarship

steps.text: If I get band seven, I'll apply to a university in the UK.

steps.prompt_uz: Chet elda o'qish (yoki boshqa katta maqsad) haqidagi rejangizni yozing (5–6 gap). Kamida 3 ta First Conditional va bitta unless / as soon as ishlating.
steps.prompt: Write about your plan to study abroad or another big goal. Use at least three first conditionals and unless or as soon as.
steps.example: I hope to study computer science in South Korea. If I get IELTS 6.5 this spring, I'll apply to three universities. If they accept me, I'll try to get a government scholarship, because the tuition fees are high. I won't be able to go unless I find cheap accommodation. As soon as I arrive, I'll join a language club so I don't feel homesick.

lessons.title: Could you tell me...?
lessons.goal_uz: Ofis, universitet va telefon suhbatida indirect (bilvosita) savollar va rasmiy iboralarni ishlatasiz.

words.ex: Could you tell me where the library is?
Do you know what time the office opens?
I was wondering if you could help me.
Do you know whether the course is free?
I'm calling with an enquiry about the course.
Is Dr Brown available this afternoon?
Hold on a moment, please.
I'll get back to you tomorrow.

steps.title: Calling the university office
steps.context_uz: Islom chet eldagi universitet qabul bo'limiga qo'ng'iroq qilmoqda.

lines.en: Good morning, Admissions Office. How can I help?
lines.uz: Xayrli tong, qabul bo'limi. Qanday yordam bera olaman?

lines.en: Hello, I'm calling with an enquiry about the summer English course. Could you tell me when it starts?
lines.uz: Salom, yozgi ingliz tili kursi bo'yicha so'rov bilan qo'ng'iroq qilyapman. Qachon boshlanishini ayta olasizmi?

lines.en: Of course. It starts on the fifth of July and lasts six weeks.
lines.uz: Albatta. 5-iyulda boshlanadi va olti hafta davom etadi.

lines.en: Great. Do you know whether accommodation is included in the price?
lines.uz: Zo'r. Narxga turar joy kiradimi-yo'qmi, bilasizmi?

lines.en: Hold on a moment, please... No, I'm afraid it isn't. But we can help you find a room.
lines.uz: Bir daqiqa kutib turing... Yo'q, afsuski kirmaydi. Lekin xona topishga yordam beramiz.

lines.en: I see. I was wondering if I could pay in two parts.
lines.uz: Tushunarli. Ikki qismda to'lasam bo'larmikan, deb so'ramoqchi edim.

lines.en: I'm not sure. Let me check with my manager and I'll get back to you by email.
lines.uz: Aniq bilmayman. Rahbarim bilan aniqlab, sizga email orqali javob beraman.

steps.body_uz:
Rasmiy vaziyatda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol qo'pol eshitilishi mumkin. Xushmuomala boshlanma qo'shamiz va **so'z tartibi tasdiq gapdek** bo'ladi:
Where **is** the library? → Could you tell me where the library **is**?
When **does** the course **start**? → Do you know when the course **starts**? (do/does yo'qoladi!)
**Ha/yo'q savollarida if / whether:** Is it free? → Do you know **if / whether** it **is** free?
Boshlanmalar: **Could you tell me...** · **Do you know...** · **I was wondering if...** · **Would you mind telling me...**
Eng ko'p xato: Could you tell me where **is** the library? ✘

examples.en: Could you tell me how much the course costs?
Do you know if Dr Brown is available?
I was wondering whether I could change my room.
examples.uz: Xonamni almashtirsam bo'ladimi, deb so'ramoqchi edim.

examples.en: Would you mind telling me where you found this?

options: Could you tell me where is the station?
Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where does the station is?
steps.explain_uz: Indirect savolda tartib: **where the station is**.

whether

steps.prompt_uz: Universitet yoki til markaziga qisqa rasmiy email yozing (5–6 gap): kurs haqida 3 ta indirect savol bering.
steps.prompt: Write a short formal email to a language school asking three indirect questions about a course.
steps.example: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to enquire about your evening IELTS course. Could you tell me when the next course starts? I would also like to know how many students there are in each group. Finally, I was wondering whether it is possible to pay in two instalments. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully, Nodira Karimova
